title: Best AI Website Builder for Small Business & Local Service in 2026
summary: We scored eight AI website builders on the eight things that actually matter to a local service business: mobile speed, a lead that goes somewhere, and a live SEO fix, not just a good-looking homepage.
body_markdown: It depends on the tool. Blink writes every submission into a managed database and can push it into a CRM or Slack without a separate subscription. Wix and Squarespace both route to a basic inbox or contact list by default, with more setup needed to connect a real CRM.
